style: Slow, calm motion in claymation stop-motion style. Keep the same scene and composition. No text changes, no new objects.

clips.prompt: A light breeze moves the paper rental signs, a lone pedestrian walks slowly down the empty street, very slow push-in
Waves roll in the wave pool, clay swimmers splash, the ferris wheel turns slowly, festive retro mood
Crowds of clay tourists walk through the street carrying shopping bags, lights twinkle, slow camera glide
A single surfing wave rolls through the empty pool, water glitters, slow aerial orbit around the turtle island
Steam rises from the hot spring hotel, clay families walk in with luggage, warm evening light, slow push-in
